Buy from **A — Brackmoor Sound**.

- Same product: Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones
- Same price: $129.00
- Same customer rating: 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
- Same shipping: In stock, free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days
- Same warranty: 1-year limited warranty

**B - Ottervale Audio:** 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.

So A gives you 60 more days to return them, at no return-shipping cost if you decide you don't like them.
